title: Experiment Configuration
description: Schema for the experiment configuration file (standard_experiment.yaml)

batch_size.description: Number of rounds to be processed simultaneously

num_speeches.description: Number of speeches that each debater will give per round

flip.description: Whether each debater will debate each side of the debate

prompt_config.description: Specifies which set of prompts to use -- if not specified, the defaults will be used

agents.description: The configuration for the debaters and judges that will be participating in the debate round

dataset.description: Configuration for the dataset to be used

enable_self_debate.description: Whether self-play is allowed or just cross-play

previous_run.description: Config that lets you reuse information from previous runs

tournament.description: A configuration that lets you specify the type of tournament you want to run. Not needed if you're using a round robin

speech_structure.description: This references the specific speech ordering you want to use. Defaults to default_debate. A preset that determines the Speech Format Type of the debaters and the judge, the default prompt name, the number of participants, and whether the position order should be flipped.

default_prompt_name.description: Name of the specific set of prompts to use

use_hardcoded_topics.description: Whether one wants to hard code the topics to debate

hardcoded_topic_config.description: The specific config that's used if use_hardcoded_topics is True

debaters.description: The configuration for the debaters. You must specify at least 1. If only 1 is specified, the model will debate itself. If more than 2 are specified, then a round robin will be performed.

model_settings.description: Specifies the configuration to be used for the model this debater will use

use_scratchpad.description: Whether the debater gets access to a scratchpad (default to false)

scratchpad_word_limit.description: Number of words that the debater can use a scratchpad for (0 or None disables scratchpad usage)

scratchpad_public.description: Whether the scratchpad generations are exposed to the other participants

n.description: The number of samples to draw

opponent_n.description: The number of opponent samples to test against

maxmin.description: Whether to select the speech with the best minimum score or the best average score

recompute.description: Whether to rejudge each speech to see which is the best

model_type.description: The type of model that is to be used. See the README for a comprehensive list of options

model_file_path.description: The path to the model weights. Not needed if the model doesn't have weights

alias.description: A name to identify the model. If this name is duplicated, then stats for those debaters will be aggregated

require_quote_validation.description: Whether quotes generated with quote tags should be validated (defaults to True)

generation_params.description: Optional configuration that controls the LLM generations

max_new_tokens.description: Max to generate in each speech, defaults to 300

top_p.description: Top p for generation, defaults to 1.0

repetition_penalty.description: Penalty for repetition, defaults to 1.2 (but is disabled based on the use_generation_penalties flag)

do_sample.description: Whether to sample from the model (True) or do greedy decoding (False)

use_generation_penalties.description: Whether to disable the repetition_penalty and exponential length penalty (False) or enable them (True)

peft_base_model.description: The path to the base model. Optional (even if one is using a peft model) but speeds up inference

is_human.description: Whether the model being used should be converted into a human debate model (which uses the real transcripts)

offline_file_path.description: Either the timestamp of the offline debate run (if the transcript is in the default output folder) or the full path to all the offline debates (Only needed if one is recreating a previously-run debate)

nucleus.description: The decoding strategy (True -> nucleus sampling [default], False -> beam search)

override_prompt.description: The name of the prompt to use for this debater only

split_type.description: The split of the data to actually use

full_dataset_file_path.description: Path to a file that stores the entire dataset. Not needed if the dataset is pre-split or if defaults are used

train_file_path.description: Path to a file that stores the training dataset. Not needed if the dataset is not pre-split or if defaults are used

val_file_path.description: Path to a file that stores the validation dataset. Not needed if the dataset is not pre-split or if defaults are used

test_file_path.description: Path to a file that stores the test dataset. Not needed if the dataset is not pre-split or if defaults are used

supplemental_file_paths.description: Set of additional kwargs that are specific to individual dataset

shuffle_deterministically.description: Whether the order of the rounds should be shuffled (False) or fixed (defaults False)

file_path.description: Path to the previous run you want to use

replicate_topics.description: Whether you want to use the same questions as the previous run (useful for making performance comparisons)

merge_results.description: Whether you want to merge the results of the previous run in the final results csv and graphs

tournament_type.description: The type of tournament to run. Options include round_robin (default), capped round robin, replication, and self_play_only

custom_matchups.description: For the custom tournament type specifically, these are the aliases that you want to debate against each other
